description.value:
Niman treats the lightsaber and the Force as two halves of one technique, blending blade-work with power use so neither ever fully yields the stage to the other. Guardians of this form step through a fight in a steady rhythm, using each cast power to set up the next strike and each strike to buy the moment needed for the next power.

Rather than choosing between spellcraft and swordplay, a Niman adept refuses the choice, meeting threats with whichever tool the moment calls for and unbalancing foes who expect only one or the other.
